identity.exactProductName: Balea PROFESSIONAL Conditioner Oil Repair Intensiv, 200 ml; GTIN 4070765001402

assumptionNotes: Current DE GTIN4070765001402 is the research unit. Mapping it to the old catalog identity remains a separately reviewed decision.
Old regional declarations are preserved only as conflicts/comparisons, not as formula continuity proof.
Manufacturer positioning and live catalog values did not determine the formula profile. No exact finished-product E3/E4 test protocol was recovered.
This is an E2 single-researcher proposal and not human-approved classification.

careDirection.derivation: Conditioner Standard v1.6; observed formula -> route-level E2 potential -> comparison profile. No catalog inheritance.
evidenceSignals: R1 cationic/fatty-alcohol base with ester and oils
Hydrolyzed Keratin rank7 supplies a distinct R5 candidate
limitations: Formula-only E2: unknown dose, deposition, sensory weight and efficacy.
careDirection.rationale: Both coherent humectant/emollient conditioning and a distinct hydrolyzed-keratin temporary fibre-film route are visible; balanced is a mixed-architecture decision, not a missing-evidence default.
thresholdReasoning: Moisture alone omits the identifiable R5 protein-film candidate in a substantive rinse-out delivery context.
Protein dominance is not established by moving keratin earlier in a declaration; robust nonprotein conditioning remains the larger architecture.

conditioningLevel.rationale: The coherent rinse-out cationic base supports substantive conditioning potential; ester and oils extend lubrication but remain correlated M1 signals.
thresholdReasoning: Above low because a complete conventional cationic/fatty-alcohol base is present with added emollients.
